page.overview:
Who is Mei Lyn?

Mei Lyn was a minor character who made her appearance in the Mortal Kombat: Conquest episode "The Essence". She was portrayed by Tiffany Phillips.

Mei Lyn was an old friend of Taja and a spa owner. They met at the market when the were young and they were friends. Kung Lao, Siro and she went Mei Lyn spa to have a rest. But while they were in the sauna Mei Lyn robbed them and escaped. Later they find her and took back their money.
